input.text: Vertical video, 10 seconds, three shots with straight cuts, silent. Shot 1 (about 3 s, static camera): a dim bedroom at night, faint street-lamp glow through a window on the left; a woman in her thirties lies on a bed seen from the foot end, right of centre, turning restlessly. Shot 2 (about 3 s, static camera): the bare mattress on its frame, centred, clean, in soft morning window light from the left, three-quarter view from slightly above. Shot 3 (about 4 s, static camera): the same woman, same face and hair, now asleep on the made bed, left of centre, still and calm, the room bright with morning light from the left. Dark to light across the three shots; the head of the bed at the top of frame in every shot. No text, captions, logos or lettering anywhere in any frame.
